mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_history ( doc_id, approver_id, approval_status, comments, action_date, approval_order ) VALUES ( #{docId}, #{approverId}, #{approvalStatus}, #{commentText}, NOW(), #{approvalOrder} )

mapper.update: UPDATE approval_history SET approval_status = #{approvalStatus}, comments = #{commentText}, action_date = #{actionDate} WHERE history_id = #{historyId}
mapper.select: SELECT history_id, doc_id, approver_id, approval_order, approval_status, comments, action_date FROM approval_history WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND approval_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY approval_order ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT AH.history_id, AH.doc_id, AH.approver_id, AH.approval_order, AH.approval_status, AH.comments, AH.action_date, U.name AS approver_name, U.rank_name AS approver_rank FROM approval_history AH JOIN users U ON AH.approver_id = U.id WHERE AH.doc_id = #{docId} AND AH.approval_order = #{currentOrder} + 1 ORDER BY AH.approval_order ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT AH.history_id, AH.doc_id, AH.approver_id, AH.approval_order, AH.approval_status, AH.comments, AH.action_date, U.name AS approver_name, U.rank_name AS approver_rank FROM approval_history AH JOIN users U ON AH.approver_id = U.id WHERE AH.doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY AH.approval_order ASC
